page.overview:
Who is Hail Mary?

Hail Mary is a gigantic kaiju creature that exists alongside many others from the second age of existence. She once fought Omni-Man and after her defeat, she was captured and enhanced by Cecil Stedman and the GDA to fight Omni-Man once more after his true motives had been revealed.

Hail Mary is an enormous kaiju, standing at least 80 feet tall, possibly even taller. She is posed on all fours, with a powerfully built, muscular body. Her head is covered in bright yellow, tentacle-like appendages that hide her mouth and any visible eyes. A terrifying mouth lurks beneath the tentacles, filled with huge, rectangular teeth in the front and a row of smaller, razor-sharp teeth behind. Hail Mary's skin is mostly dark green, with a lighter green on her underside. Sharp, white spikes stick out from her back and shoulders.

Hail Mary is one of many massive, kaiju like creatures from the second age of existence on Earth, a time that came after the first age which was filled with even more terrifying beasts. As the world moved through its different ages, she was one of the few from her age that managed to survive, eventually making it all the way to the sixth age, when humanity had taken over.

Like others of her kind, Hail Mary would rise to the surface and go on destructive rampages. Most humans, along with other beings of the sixth age, had no real understanding of where creatures like her came from or how far back their origins actually went.
